summary: Youxin Technology Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K reporting a mechanical reset of its outstanding Series A Warrants issued under Form F-1 Registration No. 333-289453. After the September 14, 2026 Periodic Adjustment Period End Date, the exercise price reset to $1.4119; after the September 8, 2026 Periodic Adjustment Date, the floor price reset to $0.278. The share count issuable under unexercised warrants is unchanged. No board recommendation, advisor, consideration, or transaction is involved. Watch dilution and future reset mechanics as a warrant-overhang consideration.
